groups.activity: Disruption; let a Ghoul Eruption conduit run its course
conditions: Only Ghoul Expired and Ghoul Rictus drop Tonkkatt; Ghoul Auger and Ghoul Devourer drop Tak & Lug instead.
When a conduit rolls 'Ghoul Eruption,' let the enemies destroy it instead of defending it, unless it's the round's last conduit, then camp that round; ghouls keep pouring out.
The Ghoul Eruption roll is random and may not appear until round 4 or later.
bonuses: Tak & Lug parts drop from the same ghouls, so farm both in one session.
Meso relics drop alongside as a side bonus.

disclosures.title: ghouls blend into regular Grineer
disclosures.body: Only Ghoul Expired and Ghoul Rictus count. People run several rounds thinking none spawned because ghouls look like ordinary Grineer mid-fight.

disclosures.title: other ghoul spots
disclosures.body: Ghoul Purge bounties and general ghoul spawns on the Plains of Eidolon drop the same parts if Olympus isn't convenient, though the conduit trick makes Olympus the fastest.
